title: The code of a functor inlined at all its uses stays in the object file, and an `[@inlined]` call in it gets warning 55
summary: `Make` is inlined at both applications, and in each copy of `run` the call `(X.step [@inlined]) x` is inlined. The code of `run` made for the functor's own body stays in the object file, called by nothing, and the compiler gives warning 55 for the call in it.

actual.text: `Error (warning 55 [inlining-impossible])`: the optimizer did not know what function was being applied.
actual.output: the optimizer did not know what function was being applied

cause: `reachable_older_code_ids` in `middle_end/flambda2/simplify/flow/data_flow_graph.ml` makes an older version of code live when two live pieces of code are newer versions of it.
